Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, basophilia, elevated ferritin, and a mildly increased INR. Inflammatory markers (CRP, D-dimer) are within or near normal limits. These findings may suggest acute infection (possibly viral), inflammation, or bone marrow involvement. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
